actions.name: AssociateDRTLogBucket
actions.description: Grants permission to authorize the DDoS Response team to access the specified Amazon S3 bucket containing your flow logs

actions.name: AssociateDRTRole
actions.description: Grants permission to authorize the DDoS Response team using the specified role, to access your AWS account to assist with DDoS attack mitigation during potential attacks

actions.name: AssociateHealthCheck
actions.description: Grants permission to add health-based detection to the Shield Advanced protection for a resource

actions.name: AssociateProactiveEngagementDetails
actions.description: Grants permission to initialize proactive engagement and set the list of contacts for the DDoS Response Team (DRT) to use

actions.name: CreateProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to activate DDoS protection service for a given resource ARN

actions.name: CreateProtectionGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to create a grouping of protected resources so they can be handled as a collective

actions.name: CreateSubscription
actions.description: Grants permission to activate subscription

actions.name: DeleteProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing protection

actions.name: DeleteProtectionGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to remove the specified protection group

actions.name: DeleteSubscription
actions.description: Grants permission to deactivate subscription

actions.name: DescribeAttack
actions.description: Grants permission to get attack details. For getting attack details protected by AWS WAF anti-DDoS managed rule group, this action additionally calls wafv2:DescribeTopContributorsByEvent to retrieve application layer attack contributors, which requires to have wafv2:DescribeTopContributorsByEvent permission in IAM policy

actions.name: DescribeAttackStatistics
actions.description: Grants permission to describe information about the number and type of attacks AWS Shield has detected in the last year

actions.name: DescribeDRTAccess
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the current role and list of Amazon S3 log buckets used by the DDoS Response team to access your AWS account while assisting with attack mitigation

actions.name: DescribeEmergencyContactSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to list the email addresses that the DRT can use to contact you during a suspected attack

actions.name: DescribeProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to get protection details

actions.name: DescribeProtectionGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the specification for the specified protection group

actions.name: DescribeSubscription
actions.description: Grants permission to get subscription details, such as start time

actions.name: DisableApplicationLayerAutomaticResponse
actions.description: Grants permission to disable application layer automatic response for Shield Advanced protection for a resource

actions.name: DisableProactiveEngagement
actions.description: Grants permission to remove authorization from the DDoS Response Team (DRT) to notify contacts about escalations

actions.name: DisassociateDRTLogBucket
actions.description: Grants permission to remove the DDoS Response team's access to the specified Amazon S3 bucket containing your flow logs

actions.name: DisassociateDRTRole
actions.description: Grants permission to remove the DDoS Response team's access to your AWS account

actions.name: DisassociateHealthCheck
actions.description: Grants permission to remove health-based detection from the Shield Advanced protection for a resource

actions.name: EnableApplicationLayerAutomaticResponse
actions.description: Grants permission to enable application layer automatic response for Shield Advanced protection for a resource

actions.name: EnableProactiveEngagement
actions.description: Grants permission to authorize the DDoS Response Team (DRT) to use email and phone to notify contacts about escalations

actions.name: GetSubscriptionState
actions.description: Grants permission to get subscription state

actions.name: ListAttacks
actions.description: Grants permission to list all existing attacks

actions.name: ListProtectionGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the protection groups for the account

actions.name: ListProtections
actions.description: Grants permission to list all existing protections

actions.name: ListResourcesInProtectionGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the resources that are included in the protection group

actions.name: ListTagsForResource
actions.description: Grants permission to get information about AWS tags for a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in AWS Shield

actions.name: TagResource
actions.description: Grants permission to add or updates tags for a resource in AWS Shield

actions.name: UntagResource
actions.description: Grants permission to remove tags from a resource in AWS Shield

actions.name: UpdateApplicationLayerAutomaticResponse
actions.description: Grants permission to update application layer automatic response for Shield Advanced protection for a resource

actions.name: UpdateEmergencyContactSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to update the details of the list of email addresses that the DRT can use to contact you during a suspected attack

actions.name: UpdateProtectionGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to update an existing protection group

actions.name: UpdateSubscription
actions.description: Grants permission to update the details of an existing subscription

actions.name: DescribeAttackContributors
actions.description: Grants permission to get detailed information about the contributors to a specific DDoS attack

actions.name: GetGlobalThreatData
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve global threat intelligence data and trends from AWS Shield's threat monitoring systems

actions.name: ListMitigations
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve a list of mitigation actions that have been applied during DDoS attacks

conditions.description: Filters actions based on the presence of tag key-value pairs in the request
Filters actions based on tag key-value pairs attached to the resource
Filters actions based on the presence of tag keys in the request
